{{Top|leg}}
The '''Third Atrisian period''' was a historical period on the planet [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], also known as Kitel Phard. It coincided with at least a part of the [[Sidereal Era]], a fairly peaceable era for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. 

The reign of the 54th Atrisian [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]], [[Uueg Tching]] occurred during this era, which saw the practical unification of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under his rule. Uueg's ''[[Sayings]]'' were composed at this time. Other Atrisian figures of that era were [[General/Legends|General]] [[Uuotse]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Daysaifor]].<ref>{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</reF>
